daily.career: Your ideas have momentum right now—this is the time to pitch, propose, or just speak up in that meeting. People are actually listening. Channel that confident energy and let your work speak for itself without second-guessing.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and sunlight today. Even a quick walk hits different when the planets are aligned like this. Listen to what feels good and honor those little urges to stretch, breathe, or rest when needed.
